name: Running Point
description: A reformed party girl must prove herself as a businesswoman when she's unexpectedly put in charge of her family's pro basketball team.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Newly installed as the Waves' president, Isla faces her first dilemma: whether to trade a foul-mouthed player who's not living up to his potential.

videos.title: Joe Pesci
videos.overview: With her brothers considering a coup, Isla must act fast to salvage a lost sponsorship. But an even bigger surprise awaits the entire Gordon family.

videos.title: The Travis Bugg Affair
videos.overview: After Travis insults a sponsor, Isla does damage control — with catastrophic results. Ali helps a bewildered Jackie adjust to his new position.

videos.title: Doljanchi
videos.overview: At the league's owners' conference, Isla chases a game-changing deal. Ness and Sandy discover that sharing a home means sharing more than just space.

videos.title: Beshert
videos.overview: Isla and Lev's long-delayed engagement party raises big questions about religion and commitment. Jackie tries to shake up the Waves' halftime show.

videos.title: The Yips
videos.overview: A false report that the Waves might trade Marcus puts Isla on the defensive. Dyson's free-throw woes call for an unusual intervention.

videos.title: A Special Place in Hell
videos.overview: To stop Travis' overbearing mom from disrupting practices, Isla takes her under her wing. Sandy and Jackie's messy love lives catch up with them.

videos.title: The Streak
videos.overview: The Waves are on a winning streak — until Jay disappears after an unexpected outburst, forcing Isla to go in search of him.

videos.title: The Playoffs
videos.overview: It's been a Cinderella season for the Waves, but a player's secret could derail their playoff dreams. Sandy tries to stage a comeback of his own.

videos.title: Game Seven
videos.overview: The team has its best playoff chances in years, while Isla's personal life couldn't be worse. Can the Gordon family come through in the clutch?

videos.title: New Coach Who Dis
videos.overview: Cam returns with promises of a fresh start — but Isla isn't ready to lower her guard. A risky coaching hire threatens to ignite a Gordon family feud.

videos.title: The Poacher
videos.overview: When a talent-stealing rival targets the Waves, Isla must fight to retain a rising star. A financial issue sparks serious concerns for Sandy.

videos.title: Triangle of Badness
videos.overview: Isla attempts to defuse a locker-room love triangle with some amateur matchmaking. Ali struggles to balance ambition and friendship.

videos.title: MVP: Marcus Very Pissed
videos.overview: As a rift develops between Marcus and Norm, Isla scrambles to mend fences. Sandy's home life is thrown off-kilter by a cheeky reality TV mishap.

videos.title: Rehearsal Dinner
videos.overview: A prenup negotiation becomes a tug-of-war between love and legacy. Ness rattles the roster when he attempts to land a star point guard.

videos.title: The Strike
videos.overview: Isla questions her conscience after a viral video ignites public backlash. A new addition shakes up the Waves' bench — and rewrites Sandy's playbook.

videos.title: We Are Broke
videos.overview: With the Waves' home-court advantage in jeopardy, Isla hustles for a lifeline. Cam schemes behind the scenes to shift the scoreboard in his favor.

videos.title: Gordons vs. McShays
videos.overview: A lease dispute sets the stage for a winner-take-all Gordon family showdown. Jackie makes a splash with a favor best handled privately.

videos.title: Et tu, Cam?
videos.overview: With the playoffs underway, betrayals and front-office intrigue leave Isla on edge. Can Dyson shake off his slump and help even the score?

videos.title: Chicago-Style
videos.overview: As the finals heat up, Isla juggles rivalries, strategies and cross-court chemistry to steer the Waves through a wildly unpredictable championship run.
